item.title: Kinshasa’s historic Zando Market set to reopen
item.description: Kinshasa’s historic Zando market is poised for a grand reopening, following a five-year, $70 million transformation led by local entrepreneur Dieudonné Bakarani. Once a chaotic hub for a million daily shoppers, the market has been reimagined with 10,000 stalls and 630 shops, modern amenities, and sustainable design features. item.title: Africa’s strongest passports in 2026
item.description: The latest Henley Passport Index reveals which African passports offer the greatest global mobility in 2026. Seychelles once again leads the continent, giving its citizens access to 154 destinations and ranking 24th globally, despite a slight dip from last year. Mauritius follows closely, offering entry to 147 destinations, while South Africa retains third place in […]

item.title: The fight to save Accra’s Ga language
item.description: Accra’s rapid growth and cosmopolitan energy are quietly pushing the Ga language toward the margins, sparking fears of cultural erasure in Ghana’s capital. As Twi and English dominate schools, markets, and public life, Ga-speaking children are increasingly taught another language as their “local” tongue, even in their native Ga communities. item.title: How Oageng Manana is shaping African design
item.description: South African designer Oageng Manana is reimagining modern interiors by fusing cultural heritage with material science.
